# BOP Integrations - 1.7.3

## What is changed?
Change version number from previous to `1.7.3`

### ➕Add:
- Document the honey mechanics feature in the README: hot-block melting, cauldron melting and jar collection, and the redesigned crystallization (world air-exposure plus cauldron heat-removal crystallization that re-melts when heated, no overheat crystallization). Design source: song682/bop-integration-catifized#31.
- Redesign honey crystallization around the cauldron. Remove the overheat solidification path for world liquid honey (Nether honey never re-crystallizes from heat) while keeping air-exposure crystallization. Honey cauldrons now crystallize their liquid contents into a solid honey block once the heat source is removed (faster when open to air, slower when covered) and re-melt when heated again, preserving the fill level via a new solid metadata bit (bit 3) exposed as a CatFrame blockstate property. Add cauldron tracking and normalized cooling progress in EventHoneyMechanics, decode level/solid in jar collection and honey-block melting, add cauldronCrystallizeOpenTime/CoveredTime config (drop crystallizeHotTime), and wire the sorted level+solid blockstate variants to the three new solid cauldron models.

### 🔧Fix:
 - fix gradle
- fix details
- Move thaumcraft compat classes into content.thaumcraft and remove the unused WorldGenNothing generator; rework honey cauldron models to reuse the vanilla empty cauldron model and reindent to 4 spaces; parameterize the CatFrame dependency via cf_version and update the Forge maven URL; fix README mod-name typos, the mixin plugin javadoc link, and the editorconfig JSON indent. Honey crystallization logic is left untouched.

### ❗❗❗Deprecated:
    - No deprecations

# BOP Integrations - 1.7.1

## What is changed?
Change version number from previous to `1.7.1`

### ➕Add:
    - Document the new BOP biome fog options (disableBopFog, minFogDistance) in the README changes list.
- Add BlockBOPFoliageGrowthMixin: late-phase IGrowable duck-type mixin enabling bone meal growth for whitelisted BlockBOPFoliage variants (config growableBopFoliage int list; built-in stages 1->2 shortgrass, 4->8 berrybush), registered as BOP_FOLIAGE_GROWTH; remove legacy berry bush block, planting event, worldgen and all their assets; drop growableBopBerry/berryClusterSize config and duplicated resources LICENSE; update README
- Add BOP biome fog config options: disableBopFog removes the biome fog color and distance entirely, minFogDistance (chunks) shifts the world fog range so it starts no closer than the configured distance. Implemented via client-side FogHandlerMixin hooking BOP's FogHandler.
- Remove the legacy TowerGlowstoneReplacer event implementation; BOPIntegrationMod now logs the HEE mixin state like the IC2 integration, since the tower glowstone swap is solely handled by MixinComponetTower under the replaceGlowStoneInTower config
- Add MixinComponetTower replacing HEE Dungeon Tower glowstone with BOP celestial crystals via @ModifyArg on ComponentTower.setupStructure, and register it in Mixins.LateMixins for the HardcoreEnderExpansion modid
- Move mixin registration from JSON lists into Mixins.java (IMixins registry): BOPIntegrationsMixinPlugin now serves NormalMixins via IMixins.getMixins; new @LateMixin BOPIntegrationsLateMixinLoader queues mixins.bopintegration.late.json serving LateMixins with IC2 gated by addRequiredMod; static mixins arrays removed from both configs; obsolete late config plugin deleted; UniMixins bumped to 0.2.1.

### 🔧Fix:
    - Fix startup crash: remove stray @Mod.Instance accidentally stacked on the @SidedProxy proxy field, which made FML try to inject the mod instance into a CommonProxy-typed field
- fix the mods
- fix the tags for better usage
- fix
- fix eol
- fix the model
- Fix BOPBiome decorator access for released BOP jar and finish Maven dependency migration. Reference BOPBiome's own decorator field by its shipped SRG name field_76760_I in applyKoruFrequencyMultiplier, because the source name theBiomeDecorator collides with the vanilla BiomeGenBase field and resolves to the inherited vanilla BiomeDecorator in the released biomes-o-plenty-2.1.0.2308 jar. Switch BOP, Thaumcraft, IC2, HEE, Baubles Expanded and Et Futurum deps from local lib jars to Maven coordinates and remove the replaced lib jars.
- fix the license

### ❗❗❗Deprecated:
    - Revert growableBopFoliage to the standard Forge getIntList read: hand-edited multi-line lists parse correctly, so the custom string-list parser, its imports and startup log are removed


## Notes
Full Changelog: https://github.com/song682/bop-integration-catifized/commits/v1.7.1
